_comment: The services OS/7 exists to reach, as DATA rather than as literals in a cmdlet.
WHY A FILE. Microsoft's endpoints depend on which cloud a tenant is in.
Azure Government and 21Vianet do not use login.microsoftonline.com, so a
hostname compiled into Test-OS7Network is simply wrong for those customers,
and wrong in a way that reports THEIR network as broken. A named set with a
default is the smallest thing that is not wrong.
NOT VERIFIED AGAINST MICROSOFT'S LIVE DOCUMENTATION. Every host below is
written from general knowledge and NONE of it was checked against Microsoft
Learn while this file was created. `verified` is null for exactly that
reason and Test-OS7Network reports it, because CLAUDE.md's rule is that
anything touching identity gets checked against Microsoft's live docs first
and that check is OWED here, not done. Treat a failure against one of these
as a question about this file before treating it as a question about the
The port is always 443 and that is deliberate: a TCP connect to the service
is the test, not ICMP to the gateway. An enterprise network that blocks ping
and permits HTTPS is ordinary, and reporting it as unreachable would be a
false alarm on the commonest configuration there is.
